title: Great Mosque of Samarra
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Great Mosque of Samarra ruin exterior:actual open enclosure ring,repeated rounded buttresses and selected shallow frieze fields,one breached northern passage,separate low platform/approach,and broad five-coil helical minaret with an open arched summit crown. Two shared graphs,three merged material roles,four authored browser levels. Current ramp geometry/heights guide the spiral;the complete upper turn reaches the crown and the final52m platform becomes its cap. The large archaeological fence and open interior are not filled or roofed. Unseen interior,current damage,exact buttress/door counts and thresholds remain approximate;no historical roof reconstruction or navigable interior.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact-QID way/1232333692 is the large archaeological-site fence,not the mosque wall. Original anchor[43.879900384,34.206219804] and heading1.263002799727 rad retained. Current named compound POI35185604422524 matches that fence. Inside it,current Malwiya relation14135984 /52776572269232 supplies the11-point enclosure and10-point open interior;platform35185431953743 and approach35185431960014 have separate exact outlines. All380 height-tagged minaret ramp parts are retained as inputs. The northern/positiveX minaret and approach establish the compound hand;two inspected exterior pictures support its ruin/enclosure/spiral form within15°visual orientation uncertainty. The fence grounds are not extruded or filled. Doorway location and unseen interior remains approximate.
